interpretation_rationale: The flagship RQ measures first-party packaged module/import reproducibility, not markets. This new, independently pinned census replaces an unavailable upstream commit reference; it does not claim reproducing the upstream study.
unit_of_analysis: one git-tracked first-party Python module import site
target_population: Complete census of first-party packaged Python modules in the exact local GitHub sync snapshot 8fee3d185c93eb4b430e5d38e21f895da2c06676, with no external generalization or market inference.

pinned_snapshot.provenance_kind: existing flattened repository sync; new independent census

inclusion_rules: Include blob entries from git ls-tree -r at the pinned immutable commit, not the mutable HEAD.
Require .py extension and top-level namespace in the 16 first-party wheel namespaces.
Use each tracked path exactly once, with its Git blob SHA from the pinned tree.
exclusion_rules: Exclude paths outside the 16 first-party package namespaces, including test harness and documentation roots.
Exclude console entrypoint declarations from module count; they belong to the packaging-contract gate.

coverage.tree_snapshot_verified_via: GitHub Git tree API at 8fee3d185c93eb4b430e5d38e21f895da2c06676; truncated=false

missingness.sampling_missingness: not applicable; complete finite tree census
missingness.unresolved_upstream_provenance: Historical b012d3da commit absent from this repository; old population counts and digest are not claimed verified by this revision.

population_digest.construction: SHA-256 of sorted UTF-8 lines "{path} {git_blob_sha}\n" for the filtered immutable git tree; identical to check_population_frame.compute_frame_digest

limitations: Snapshot-only proof over exactly one existing sync commit; no external-validity claim.
This is a new census, not a reproduction of the old upstream b012d3da snapshot or its reported 1,539-module population.
Infrastructure-only / synthetic-control boundaries; no market datasets, returns, trading alpha, or deployment claims.
Member counts and digest must be independently recomputed by check_population_frame.py before treating this manifest as verified.
